Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, proteinuria, hematuria, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, all strongly indicative of a urinary tract infection. The low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
